text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The summer camp has arrived once again. A chance encounter with Maruzensky gives Grass Wonder the opportunity to speak with her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a brief exchange, Maruzensky leaves. Her shadow looms large in Grass Wonder's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Grass Wonder has grown much over the past year. And she isn't finished yet, so let's start this summer camp!
